## FA-002 / ZEUS-7fcc5f0308e7 revision 1 — Refs #3

### Defect (agreed in cross-review)
Upstream curator lessons carry `occurrences` incremented on every re-harvest and `ledger:PASS xN` tokens that are cumulative project PASS counts; `trust: confirmed` follows from bake time + two harvests. `occurrences: 308` therefore means 308 harvest cycles, not 308 independent incidents. Zeus must not inherit these as approval, qualification or recurrence counts.

### Change
- `domain/experience.py`: frontmatter split, string-only field validation, evidence-token classification, `experience_claim`. Upstream fields are preserved verbatim under `upstream`; independent occurrences are recomputed only from incident-identifying tokens (`incident:`, `occurrence:`, `ledger-event:`, `task:`). Counters and `repair-notes:*` count zero → `upstream_occurrences_unverified`.
- `application/experience.py`: append-only `experience_claims` bucket; ID = (rule version, source, path, byte SHA-256); identical bytes re-import is a no-op; pinned/observed bytes of one path are ordered versions; same ID with different content is rejected.
- `adapters/experience.py`: explicit files/directories only, raw bytes archived to artifacts, `--dry-run` writes nothing. Frontmatter YAML reuses `project_skills.load_yaml` (string-only, no tags, unique keys, size/expansion limits) — `load_yaml` gained a message label parameter.
- `docs/contracts.md`: `INV-EXPERIENCE-001`.
- `docs/zeus/implementation/experience-claims-001/`: record, probe, receipt.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| Receipt over the 25 actual local upstream lessons (preview, no DB/artifact write) | 25/25 SHA-256 match the partition inventory's observed entries; upstream occurrences sum 2,692; independent recomputed 0; 25× `upstream_occurrences_unverified` |
| `tests/test_experience.py` (11): verbatim preservation, identity dedup, nested/multi-line YAML kept as data, 9 malformed inputs rejected explicitly (incl. `!!python` tag), version separation + idempotent re-import, tampered ID rejected, **25 imported claims + one real `record_incident` → no hook**, CLI dry-run writes nothing | pass |
| `test_architecture`, `test_project_skills` (loader change) | pass |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 930 passed, 305 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
No upstream lesson carries an incident identity, so independent recurrence cannot be reconstructed from this data — only preserved and labelled. Advisory injection of experience into Codex task context (design/implementation only) is a separate follow-up from the cross-review and is not in this PR. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
